method:
Use both the positive prompt and Negative Prompt with Nano Banana Pro; retain the negative section. Keep the low camera angle, downward gaze, hands in pockets and loose turtleneck. Adjust hair, clothing or colours while preserving clean cel-shaded shapes, a pink rim and blue-purple shadows. Check the pose and ensure the result remains an illustration rather than photography or 3D.

Limitations: This is a still illustration, not animation or a pose sheet. No franchise character or reference photo is required by the recipe. The prompt gives no numeric ratio. The source file is 672 × 1200 pixels; proposed Studio 9:16 is a close starting choice, not proof of an original setting. How negative instructions are interpreted depends on the model.

variants.label: Low-Angle Neon Anime Fashion Portrait
variants.promptText:
A retro-modern anime digital painting of a chic young woman in a dramatic low-angle perspective. Tousled dark shoulder-length wavy hair, straight wispy micro-bangs, silver hoop earrings, subtle warm makeup, looking down toward the camera with a calm, aloof gaze. Wearing a loose, baggy black oversized turtleneck with draped sleeves tucked into high-waisted black casual trousers, hands in pockets. Atmospheric neon split-lighting, warm pink rim light contrasting against deep purple and midnight-blue ambient shadows, clean graphic vector edges, cel-shaded anime style, smooth cobalt blue to hot pink gradient backdrop, synthwave color palette, cinematic lighting, masterpiece.

Negative Prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, deformed hands, distorted face, extra limbs, dull colors, noisy background, high clutter, low quality, sketch, messy lines.

purpose: Design a low-angle fashion character portrait with a readable black silhouette and pink rim light against a blue-purple setting.
summary: A black fashion silhouette against a blue-pink gradient with crisp cel shading and neon rim light.
title: Low-Angle Neon Anime Fashion Portrait
